metadata.title: Sign the Pledge - Erase Horseracing India
metadata.description: Join thousands in pledging to never attend or support horse racing. Stand with us for change.

hero.title: Take the Pledge
hero.subtitle: Join thousands of compassionate people across India who refuse to support an industry built on animal suffering. Your voice matters.

cards.title: Build a Movement
cards.text: Every signature strengthens our collective voice. When thousands pledge, lawmakers and industry leaders must listen.

cards.title: Create Economic Pressure
cards.text: By refusing to attend races, we demonstrate that there's no social license for this exploitation. The industry cannot survive without public support.

cards.title: Support Legal Action
cards.text: Your pledge demonstrates public opposition to racing, strengthening legal challenges and policy advocacy efforts.

cards.title: Honor the Horses
cards.text: Each pledge is a promise to the horses who have suffered: their deaths will not be in vain, and we will fight for change.

pledge.title: The Pledge
pledge.text: I pledge to never attend, support, or bet on horse racing. I recognize that horse racing causes preventable suffering and death. I commit to speaking out against this exploitation and supporting efforts to end horse racing in India.

steps.title: Your pledge is recorded
steps.text: We'll add your name to our growing list of supporters fighting to end horse racing.

steps.title: Stay informed
steps.text: You'll receive updates on our campaigns, legal victories, and opportunities to take further action.

steps.title: Amplify your impact
steps.text: Share your pledge on social media and encourage others to join. Change happens when we speak up together.
